text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black ran splendidly in the Osaka 
Hai. Satono Diamond, who was about to run 
in the Satsuki Sho, drew great courage 
from her performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, her rival Brusqueman made her 
comeback. After a strong showing in 
overseas races, she returned home.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black's next goal is the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)... However, Brusquemente's next 
move was also a matter of concern.
